data: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_integration (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, space_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES spacemodel(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, allowed_run_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, credential_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, credential_nonce VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, key_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, credential_hash_prefix VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_by_id UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_webhook_integration_space_active ON webhook_integration (space_id, active)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_result_mapping (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, integration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_integration(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, external_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, result_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES test_result(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, run_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES test_run(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_mapping_external UNIQUE (integration_id, external_id), CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_mapping_result UNIQUE (integration_id, result_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_webhook_mapping_run ON webhook_result_mapping (integration_id, run_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_request (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, integration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_integration(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, request_id UUID NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, nonce_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, error_code VARCHAR(64) NULL, result_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_request_idempotency UNIQUE (integration_id, idempotency_key), CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_request_nonce UNIQUE (integration_id, nonce_hash), CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_request_request_id UNIQUE (request_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_webhook_request_integration_time ON webhook_request (integration_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_nonce (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, integration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_integration(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, nonce_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_nonce UNIQUE (integration_id, nonce_hash))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_webhook_nonce_integration_time ON webhook_nonce (integration_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_result_provenance (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, result_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES test_result(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, integration_id UUID NOT NULL, integration_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, request_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_request(request_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
